services.name: Fly Fishing
services.desc: Join us for guided ice fishing trips from late November to mid-April, depending on ice conditions. Dillon Reservoir is known for its plentiful Arctic Char, Kokanee Salmon, Brown Trout, and Rainbow Trout while Green Mountain Reservoir boasts larger Kokanee Salmon, big Lake Trout and Northern Pike! We provide everything you need for a fantastic ice fishing experience, including heated huts, tackle, bait, seating and ice fishing sonars. Dress warmly, like you’re going skiing! Please bring your own food and drinks. We invite participants of all ages, abilities, and fishing skills!
